args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Cover-ups/sarongs
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Shorts and t-shirts
- Light long pants (for evenings/mosquito protection)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and rocky beaches)
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Beach towel
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case/dry bag
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes with good grip
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent
- Sun hat
- Bandana/buff

FORMAL/CASUAL EVENING WEAR:
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Luau-appropriate attire (aloha shirt, sundress)
- Light dress/smart casual outfit

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Medications
- First aid kit
- Contact lenses/glasses and solution
- Makeup (if applicable)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Eye mask
- Snacks
- Small backpack/day bag
- Ziplock bags (for wet items, electronics protection)
- Travel laundry detergent (for hand washing)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Waikiki Beach: Beach toys, cooler
- Hanauma Bay Snorkeling: Underwater camera
- Diamond Head Hike: Trekking poles, extra water
- Pearl Harbor: Respectful attire (covered shoulders/knees)
- North Shore Road Trip: Car snacks, playlist
- Polynesian Cultural Center Luau: Floral shirt/dress
- Kailua Beach Kayaking: Waterproof watch
- Ala Moana Shopping: Reusable shopping bags
